// Part of the Dim Factory web starter. MIT License: copy, change and share it freely.
// A small router for a single-page site: the address bar's path picks the page, links change it without a reload,
// and the browser's Back and Forward buttons work. Hosts send every address to index.html (public/_redirects, and
// dist/404.html for GitHub Pages), so an address typed or shared directly opens the right page too.
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
import type { AnchorHTMLAttributes, MouseEvent, ReactNode } from 'react'

interface RouterValue {
  path: string
  hash: string
  navigate: (to: string) => void
}

const RouterContext = createContext<RouterValue | null>(null)

function current(): { path: string; hash: string } {
  return { path: window.location.pathname || '/', hash: window.location.hash }
}

export function RouterProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [where, setWhere] = useState(current)

  useEffect(() => {
    const onPop = () => setWhere(current())
    window.addEventListener('popstate', onPop)
    return () => window.removeEventListener('popstate', onPop)
  }, [])

  const navigate = useCallback((to: string) => {
    const url = new URL(to, window.location.href)
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) {
      window.location.assign(url.href)
      return
    }
    window.history.pushState(null, '', url.pathname + url.search + url.hash)
    setWhere({ path: url.pathname, hash: url.hash })
  }, [])

  const value = useMemo(() => ({ ...where, navigate }), [where, navigate])
  return <RouterContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</RouterContext.Provider>
}

export function useRoute(): RouterValue {
  const value = useContext(RouterContext)
  if (value === null) throw new Error('useRoute is used outside RouterProvider')
  return value
}

type LinkProps = Omit<AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, 'href'> & { to: string }

/** A link inside the site: no page reload, and `aria-current="page"` on the link to the page you are on. */
export function Link({ to, onClick, children, ...rest }: LinkProps) {
  const { path, navigate } = useRoute()
  const target = new URL(to, window.location.href)
  const internal = target.origin === window.location.origin
  const active = internal && target.pathname === path && target.hash === ''
  const handle = (e: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    onClick?.(e)
    if (e.defaultPrevented || !internal || e.button !== 0) return
    if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.altKey || rest.target === '_blank') return
    e.preventDefault()
    navigate(to)
  }
  return (
    <a href={to} onClick={handle} aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined} {...rest}>
      {children}
    </a>
  )
}
